characters.name: PEETER
characters.description: Väike inimene, pruunide lühikeste juuste ja sõbraliku naeratusega poiss, kandmas sinist kampsunit ja pruune pükse. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: LIISA
characters.description: Väike inimene, heledate patsidega ja rõõmsameelne tüdruk, kandmas punast kampsunit ning kollaseid kummikuid. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: Sunny outdoor garden in autumn with green grass scattered with colorful red and yellow fallen leaves. A large oak tree with autumn foliage stands on the left side, and a simple low wooden fence sits in the background under a clear blue sky. Bright crisp autumn lighting. Cartoon style.
